programs.name: Explore Microsoft Program (Explore Internship)

source.note: Program page readable. Formal eligibility criteria live on a separate page: https://careers.microsoft.com/v2/global/en/internship_eligibility . No Summer 2027 dates, no application-open date, and no F-1/CPT/OPT language appear on the Explore page itself.

class_year.quote: Candidate must be a 1st or 2nd year full time enrolled bachelor student (Freshmen/Sophomore) during the academic term immediately before their internship.

process.quote: Candidates need to apply online to be considered. The interview process varies depending on the role. Interview preparation and details are communicated to candidates when they are invited to interviews. All interviews are conducted virtually.

compensation.quote: Our salaries are competitive for the tech industry. All job postings will include the base pay range.

cooling_off.quote: All candidates must submit a new application each year. Interview spots are limited, so being selected for an interview is never a guarantee
cooling_off.notes: This is the closest thing Microsoft publishes to a reapplication rule, and it is NOT a cooling-off period — it is the answer to the FAQ question 'I interviewed last year, can I skip to the final round of interviews this year?' and it requires a fresh application each year rather than imposing a wait. The quote is reproduced exactly as it appears, including the missing terminal period. Microsoft's Early in Profession FAQ (https://careers.microsoft.com/v2/global/en/universityinternship) and the internship eligibility page (https://careers.microsoft.com/v2/global/en/internship_eligibility) were both read in full: NEITHER states any waiting period after rejection, any assessment-retake rule, or any cap on the number of applications per cycle. That is silence in the public record, not evidence that no such rule exists internally. The eligibility page does state a separate restriction on consecutive internships — see the University Internship row.

programs.cycle: Summer 2027 / 2026-2027 cycle — no cycle-specific opening date published as of 2026-07-29
programs.location: Redmond WA, Atlanta GA, and India campuses (per program page)

programs.name: Microsoft University Internship

source.note: Region-segmented eligibility table. Quotes below are from the United States / Canada / Latin America block.

class_year.quote: Candidate must be enrolled in a full time bachelor's, masters, MBA, or PhD program in area relevant for the role during the academic term immediately before their internship.

process.quote: Recruiters will continue accepting applications until all positions are filled. A recruiter will review your application and contact you directly if you are selected for interviews. You can track the real-time status of your application on your action center on the Microsoft careers site. Please allow up to 90 days to receive a decision on your application. Be sure to check both the "Active" and "Inactive" folders in the Action Center.

compensation.quote: Our salaries are competitive for the tech industry. All job postings will include the base pay range.

cooling_off.quote: Candidate can not complete 2 back to back internships with Microsoft.
cooling_off.notes: This is a restriction on consecutive internships (triggered by having interned, not by rejection or by an assessment attempt). It appears in the United States / Canada / Latin America block alongside 'Candidate must be returning to school for 1 full academic term post internship.' It is NOT a post-rejection cooling-off period. No post-rejection waiting period and no application cap is published on either the FAQ or the eligibility page.
